title: Copy a primitive immutable list into a larger array
summary: The primitive list copied four values into the caller’s oversized array. Spare cells retained their sentinels and changing the array left the list intact.

change.description: Limit the primitive array copy to the number of list elements.

notes: The copied interval is [0,4). Later writes to a caller-owned copy cannot mutate immutable list storage.
With identical compiled caller bytes, 8.5.13 matched the parent and 8.5.14 matched the landing on all three histories.
